resources.string: Sleevesight reads what a player says it is playing (track, artist, album). It does not receive the audio or your other notifications. Android grants this with notification access. Switch on the players you want Sleevesight to follow. A player not switched on is only checked for music, a track with a title and an artist, to be listed here; nothing of it is kept or sent. Calls from the phone app, and sessions Android marks as voice calls, are never read.
External services providing information on artists and music.

Sleevesight pulls information about the currently played music from services dedicated to music and from general information sources. Switch on the services you want Sleevesight to get information from.

Sleevesight uses LLMs to process, aggregate, and present information retrieved from sources. Use the settings to specify the model and effort; stronger models and higher effort provide better results at a higher cost. One service at a time; a service switched off keeps its model and effort.
Private API keys enabling external services
Show this phone’s name to the computer

For Type on a computer: while its session is open, the phone advertises its Bluetooth name, so the computer’s list shows the phone by it. Anyone nearby scanning for Bluetooth can see the name meanwhile. Off: the phone is the only device listed, as “Unknown or Unsupported Device”.

Sleevesight uses external services that require authentication via API keys, obtained from each service’s own website. Your keys are stored encrypted on this phone, and each is sent only to its own service.
Sleevesight collects genre information from sources and compiles a short list of representative categories.
Sleevesight collects track, artist, and album information from sources and uses AI to generate readable descriptions based on the sourced evidence.
Listening history, kept on this phone.
Sleevesight keeps the tracks you play on this phone, to avoid repeating itself within a listening session and to learn which track changes are your skips. Nothing of it leaves the phone.
Detailed information about the design, implementation, dependencies, licencing, and policies.
An open music encyclopedia: recordings, releases, credits and release dates.
Articles on songs, albums and artists, and the facts behind them.

Tags added freely by listeners, unmoderated; Sleevesight keeps those that name a genre.
